Now, dodge the plumbers that the enemy throws at you, and then use Scrooge's cane to jump off the top of that enemy in order to reach the rope without paying the statue. Second Extra Hit Point For the second Hit Point, move right across the level, until you reach the first pit. Jump down this pit and keep falling until you reach the bottom floor. Just move left until you reach Bubba. To save Bubba just hit the block underneath him with your cane and cane jump from the block to above the ice, which intraps him. On the balcony where the game starts, do not go into the palace's room and instead, push in the left joystick and enter GREEN, BLUE, YELLOW, RED, YELLOW, GREEN, BLUE, RED (A, X, Y, B, Y, A, X, B). Unlock Prince of Persia 2 To find this goodie, you'll need to start from the Above the Baths save, once you have your new sword. Go down the stairwell that leads to a large carvernous area. After you make it through this area, you'll end up in a small room with Farah. There's a lever and gear in the center of the room. Turn it cockwise until it clicks twice. Both doors in the room are now closed, but you have also opened a secret door that you cannot see. Go to the wall directly opposite the entrance. Swing until you find a spot on the wall where your sword doesn't spark. Strike this area a few times to reveal a hidden room. Enter to unlock the game, which is now available from the main menu. Features: DuckTales: Stage-Select DuckTales 2: Stage-Select, Repeatable Levels for Money ■————————————— CHEATS: DuckTales (NES), Disney's GLITCHES Huge time bonus Beat a boss and collect its treasure just as the timer runs out. When it comes time for the time bonus to be collected, the timer wraps around into letters, giving you a whopping $325,000. UNLOCKABLES Bad ending Complete the game with exactly zero dollars to unlock the bad ending. SECRETS Bonus Stage When your score has a 7 as the 10-thousands digit(for example 170,000), call Launchpad to take you back home; he will drop you off at a secret bonus stage. Extra Hit Point At the right extreme of the second floor, there is a large coffin which is marked ”R-I-P”;. Cane jump on top of that coffin and you can walk through the right wall, which happens to be an illusionary wall. On the other side of this wall there is a chest, which contains the extra hit point. Get past the talking statue without paying In the Amazon level, when you will eventually get to a big gray statue that will offer you a way up if you pay a certain amount of money. Choose ''No'' and then make Scrooge turn around and walk a little to his left. You should see one of the enemies that throw plungers at you approaching. Place yourself right under the rope that is at the top of the screen. Now, dodge the plumbers that the enemy throws at you, and then use Scrooge's cane to jump off the top of that enemy in order to reach the rope without paying the statue. Hidden Ending Score at least $10,000,000 and then beat the game. You'll see a slightly different ending. Refill Your Energy If you have 3,000,000 in your total, you can refill your energy anytime by pressing Select. Each time you press Select, you will consume that amount. Second Extra Hit Point For the second Hit Point, move right across the level, until you reach the first pit. Jump down this pit and keep falling until you reach the bottom floor. Just move left until you reach Bubba. To save Bubba just hit the block underneath him with your cane and cane jump from the block to above the ice, which intraps him. He shows you a treasure chest, which contains the second extra hit point in the game.

UNLOCKABLES Bad ending Complete the game with exactly zero dollars to unlock the bad ending. Extra Hit Point At the right extreme of the second floor, there is a large coffin which is marked ”R-I-P”;. Get past the talking statue without paying In the Amazon level, when you will eventually get to a big gray statue that will offer you a way up if you pay a certain amount of money. Choose ''No'' and then make Scrooge turn around and walk a little to his left. You should see one of the enemies that throw plungers at you approaching. Place yourself right under the rope that is at the top of the screen. Now, dodge the plumbers that the enemy throws at you, and then use Scrooge's cane to jump off the top of that enemy in order to reach the rope without paying the statue. Hidden Ending Score at least $10,000,000 and then beat the game. You'll see a slightly different ending. Refill Your Energy If you have 3,000,000 in your total, you can refill your energy anytime by pressing Select. Each time you press Select, you will consume that amount. Second Extra Hit Point For the second Hit Point, move right across the level, until you reach the first pit. Jump down this pit and keep falling until you reach the bottom floor. Just move left until you reach Bubba. To save Bubba just hit the block underneath him with your cane and cane jump from the block to above the ice, which intraps him. When it comes time for the time bonus to be collected, the timer wraps around into letters, giving you a whopping $325,000. UNLOCKABLES Bad ending Complete the game with exactly zero dollars to unlock the bad ending. SECRETS Bonus Stage When your score has a 7 as the 10-thousands digit(for example 170,000), call Launchpad to take you back home; he will drop you off at a secret bonus stage. Extra Hit Point At the right extreme of the second floor, there is a large coffin which is marked ”R-I-P”;. Cane jump on top of that coffin and you can walk through the right wall, which happens to be an illusionary wall. On the other side of this wall there is a chest, which contains the extra hit point. Get past the talking statue without paying In the Amazon level, when you will eventually get to a big gray statue that will offer you a way up if you pay a certain amount of money. Choose ''No'' and then make Scrooge turn around and walk a little to his left. You should see one of the enemies that throw plungers at you approaching. Place yourself right under the rope that is at the top of the screen. Now, dodge the plumbers that the enemy throws at you, and then use Scrooge's cane to jump off the top of that enemy in order to reach the rope without paying the statue. Hidden Ending Score at least $10,000,000 and then beat the game. You'll see a slightly different ending. Refill Your Energy If you have 3,000,000 in your total, you can refill your energy anytime by pressing Select. Each time you press Select, you will consume that amount. Second Extra Hit Point For the second Hit Point, move right across the level, until you reach the first pit. Jump down this pit and keep falling until you reach the bottom floor. Just move left until you reach Bubba. To save Bubba just hit the block underneath him with your cane and cane jump from the block to above the ice, which intraps him. He shows you a treasure chest, which contains the second extra hit point in the game. ■————————————— Disney's DuckTales 2 (NES) UNLOCKABLES Another Alternate Ending If you beat the game with no money at all, you get to see an alternate ending where the McDuck family name is shamed. On the balcony where the game starts, do not go into the palace's room and instead, push in the left joystick and enter GREEN, BLUE, YELLOW, RED, YELLOW, GREEN, BLUE, RED (A, X, Y, B, Y, A, X, B). Unlock Prince of Persia 2 To find this goodie, you'll need to start from the Above the Baths save, once you have your new sword. Go down the stairwell that leads to a large carvernous area. After you make it through this area, you'll end up in a small room with Farah. There's a lever and gear in the center of the room. Turn it cockwise until it clicks twice. Both doors in the room are now closed, but you have also opened a secret door that you cannot see. Go to the wall directly opposite the entrance. Swing until you find a spot on the wall where your sword doesn't spark. Strike this area a few times to reveal a hidden room. Enter to unlock the game, which is now available from the main menu. DuckTales 2: Stage-Select, Repeatable Levels for Money
Beat a boss and collect its treasure just as the timer runs out. When it comes time for the time bonus to be collected, the timer wraps around into letters, giving you a whopping $325,000.
Complete the game with exactly zero dollars to unlock the bad ending.
When your score has a 7 as the 10-thousands digit(for example 170,000), call Launchpad to take you back home; he will drop you off at a secret bonus stage.

At the right extreme of the second floor, there is a large coffin which is marked ”R-I-P”;. Cane jump on top of that coffin and you can walk through the right wall, which happens to be an illusionary wall. On the other side of this wall there is a chest, which contains the extra hit point.
Get past the talking statue without paying

In the Amazon level, when you will eventually get to a big gray statue that will offer you a way up if you pay a certain amount of money. Choose ''No'' and then make Scrooge turn around and walk a little to his left. You should see one of the enemies that throw plungers at you approaching. Place yourself right under the rope that is at the top of the screen. Now, dodge the plumbers that the enemy throws at you, and then use Scrooge's cane to jump off the top of that enemy in order to reach the rope without paying the statue.
Score at least $10,000,000 and then beat the game. You'll see a slightly different ending.
If you have 3,000,000 in your total, you can refill your energy anytime by pressing Select. Each time you press Select, you will consume that amount.

For the second Hit Point, move right across the level, until you reach the first pit. Jump down this pit and keep falling until you reach the bottom floor. Just move left until you reach Bubba. To save Bubba just hit the block underneath him with your cane and cane jump from the block to above the ice, which intraps him. He shows you a treasure chest, which contains the second extra hit point in the game.
If you beat the game with no money at all, you get to see an alternate ending where the McDuck family name is shamed.
If you manage to collect all seven map pieces and McDuck's lost treasure you get a better ending to the game with some different scenes.

DuckTales 2: Stage-Select, Repeatable Levels for Money
Beat a boss and collect its treasure just as the timer runs out. When it comes time for the time bonus to be collected, the timer wraps around into letters, giving you a whopping $325,000.
Complete the game with exactly zero dollars to unlock the bad ending.
When your score has a 7 as the 10-thousands digit(for example 170,000), call Launchpad to take you back home; he will drop you off at a secret bonus stage.

At the right extreme of the second floor, there is a large coffin which is marked ”R-I-P”;. Cane jump on top of that coffin and you can walk through the right wall, which happens to be an illusionary wall. On the other side of this wall there is a chest, which contains the extra hit point.
Get past the talking statue without paying

In the Amazon level, when you will eventually get to a big gray statue that will offer you a way up if you pay a certain amount of money. Choose ''No'' and then make Scrooge turn around and walk a little to his left. You should see one of the enemies that throw plungers at you approaching. Place yourself right under the rope that is at the top of the screen. Now, dodge the plumbers that the enemy throws at you, and then use Scrooge's cane to jump off the top of that enemy in order to reach the rope without paying the statue.
Score at least $10,000,000 and then beat the game. You'll see a slightly different ending.
If you have 3,000,000 in your total, you can refill your energy anytime by pressing Select. Each time you press Select, you will consume that amount.

For the second Hit Point, move right across the level, until you reach the first pit. Jump down this pit and keep falling until you reach the bottom floor. Just move left until you reach Bubba. To save Bubba just hit the block underneath him with your cane and cane jump from the block to above the ice, which intraps him. He shows you a treasure chest, which contains the second extra hit point in the game.

Start a new game with any profile. On the balcony where the game starts, do not go into the palace's room and instead, push in the left joystick and enter GREEN, BLUE, YELLOW, RED, YELLOW, GREEN, BLUE, RED (A, X, Y, B, Y, A, X, B).

To find this goodie, you'll need to start from the Above the Baths save, once you have your new sword. Go down the stairwell that leads to a large carvernous area. After you make it through this area, you'll end up in a small room with Farah. There's a lever and gear in the center of the room. Turn it cockwise until it clicks twice. Both doors in the room are now closed, but you have also opened a secret door that you cannot see. Go to the wall directly opposite the entrance. Swing until you find a spot on the wall where your sword doesn't spark. Strike this area a few times to reveal a hidden room. Enter to unlock the game, which is now available from the main menu.
Beat the game and Prince of Persia 1 becomes available in the Extra Features menu.
